summary: Iteration 11 — France Travail (Pôle Emploi) Offres v2 OAuth2 + La Bonne Alternance source addition to OffersPage. Backend (10/10 PASSED, pytest_iter11.xml): GET /api/francetravail/search?city=Paris&per_page=5 → 200 {results,total,cache_hit:false}, ≥1 offer with source='FranceTravail', offer_id ft_*, apply_url pointing to candidat.francetravail.fr; 2nd identical call → cache_hit:true with same total (TTL 4h confirmed); no-params call defaults dept=75 returns ≥1 result; departement=69 works; city=Lyon returns offers with department='69'; domain=informatique correctly forwards codeROME=M1805,M1810,M1802,M1803 (verified at least one result with a code from that set); DELETE /api/admin/ft-cache → 200 {ok:true, deleted:N} for admin, 403 for candidate, 401/403 without auth; api_request_logs records api_name='francetravail' (visible via /api/admin/api-stats by_api list with calls=18, cache_hits=8, avg_ms~350, errors=0); OAuth token cache works implicitly (10 successive search calls completed in 5.27s real-time). Frontend Playwright (7/7 PASSED on preview URL): /offers Source select contains both 'La Bonne Alternance ★' and 'France Travail' option labels; /offers?source=FranceTravail&city=Paris → 50 offer-card-ft_* cards, 0 lba_*, 0 off_* (mode FT-only); first FT card is <a target=_blank href=https://candidat.francetravail.fr/offres/recherche/detail/{id}>; FT source badge displays 'France Travail ✓'; /offers?source=La%20Bonne%20Alternance&city=Lyon → 30 offer-card-lba_* cards, 0 ft_* (LBA-only) with badge text 'LBA'; /admin admin-cache block has all 4 buttons purge-ft + purge-lba + purge-search + purge-all; clicking purge-ft fires DELETE /api/admin/ft-cache → 200 (toast 'Cache France Travail vidé').

minor.issue: No Pydantic Query bounds on per_page (FT API caps at 50 via the range computation, but values <=0 or >50 are silently clamped, no 4xx returned).

normalize_ft_offer.city extraction uses split(' - ', 1)[-1] which on libelle='75 - PARIS 10' returns 'PARIS 10' (good), but on libelle='Paris' alone returns 'Paris' (still ok). On libelle without delimiter the logic is fragile; acceptable for now.

normalize_ft_offer.department uses commune[:2] (5-digit INSEE), but commune for Paris arrondissements is 75056/75101/...; commune[:2]='75' so OK. For Lyon arrondissement (69381 etc.), commune[:2]='69' OK. However, when commune is missing the field becomes None. Could fall back to lieuTravail.libelle prefix instead.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Add Pydantic Query(ge=1, le=50) bounds for per_page on /api/francetravail/search and return 422 instead of silently clamping.
(OPTIONAL) Defensive fallback in normalize_ft_offer.department when commune is missing — derive from postalCode[:2] or lieuTravail.libelle prefix.
(OPTIONAL) Add an audit-log entry for DELETE /api/admin/ft-cache (same recommendation as iter10 for /api/admin/lba-cache).
(OPTIONAL) francetravail.py still uses requests.get/post inside run_in_executor — consider migrating to httpx.AsyncClient for consistency (same recommendation as iter10 for labonnealternance.py).
critical_code_review_comments: francetravail.py contract_type derivation (lines 91-95) is hard to follow and has a logic bug: `raw.get('natureContrat', '').lower().startswith('contrat apprentissage')` will always be False because natureContrat is a 2-letter code ('E1','E2','FA','FS'), not a label. The `raw.get('alternance')` and `natureContrat in ('E2','FS')` checks save it, but the startswith branch is dead code. Simplify.
francetravail.py: cache TTL of 4 hours is hard-coded. Extracting to env var (FT_CACHE_TTL_HOURS) would mirror LBA cache pattern.
server.py is now 3779 lines (vs 3716 in iter10). Reiterating: split into routers/ submodules (lists, ai, admin, lba, ft) to stay under the 700-line ceiling — same comment as iter9/iter10.

server.py CITY_TO_DEPT is hard-coded with only ~20 cities. Lille, Caen, Limoges, Clermont-Ferrand and many others fall back to dept=75 (Paris). Either expand the table from a CSV or call a geocoding service.

OfferCard.jsx isExternalUrl branch (line 24) opens FT URLs in a new tab which is correct for legal compliance (FT terms require redirection to candidat.francetravail.fr), but the click-through is not logged in api_request_logs → analytics will under-count actual application intents. Consider POST /api/offers/{id}/click before redirect.

Iter11 introduces a 3rd external source (FT) in addition to LBA — the dedup logic in OffersPage Promise.all([fetchInternal, fetchLba, fetchFt]) does no de-duplication across LBA/FT for the same SIRET+title pair. If the same alternance is posted on both portals it shows twice.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 critical flows: Source select labels, FT-only mode card counts, FT card external href, FT badge label, LBA-only mode card counts, LBA badge stays 'LBA', admin purge-ft button + DELETE /api/admin/ft-cache 200)

seed_data_creation: None for this iteration. ft_search_cache collection was populated for Paris (default + per_page=5 + per_page=3), departement=69, city=Lyon, domain=informatique queries during testing — cleared by purge in fixture and again by purge-ft frontend click at the end. Final state contains 1 fresh warm entry (city=Paris per_page=3) which the main agent can clear via DELETE /api/admin/ft-cache if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: France Travail backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_ft.py — run `pytest backend/tests/test_iter11_ft.py -v`. Real FT Offres v2 API at https://api.francetravail.io with OAuth2 client_credentials (FT_CLIENT_ID/FT_CLIENT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env). Token cached in francetravail._token_cache dict ~1500s, auto-refreshed. Search cache in MongoDB ft_search_cache collection with cache_key = sorted params join, TTL 4h. CITY_TO_DEPT map at server.py:3684 covers only top-20 French cities — unknown cities fall back to dept=75. FT cards on /offers render as <a target=_blank> when source=FranceTravail (OfferCard.jsx isExternalUrl branch). SOURCES array (OffersPage.jsx:18) is now object form {id,label}. Admin /admin page has 4 purge buttons: purge-ft, purge-lba, purge-search, purge-all — all functional. /api/admin/api-stats returns by_api as a LIST (not dict) with _id field — important for any subsequent assertions.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The France Travail OAuth2 + Offres v2 integration is fully working end-to-end against the real gouv.fr API (no mocks), with proper token caching, 4-hour search cache, admin-protected purge endpoint, and analytics logging. Frontend correctly differentiates LBA-only vs FT-only modes via the Source dropdown, renders FT cards as external <a target=_blank> links to candidat.francetravail.fr (FT ToS-compliant redirection), displays the new 'France Travail ✓' badge label while preserving the existing 'LBA' badge for La Bonne Alternance, and exposes the purge-ft button on /admin. All 16 acceptance criteria from the review_request are validated.
